audit.why: Both layers read Jax on all seven rows and the packet chart agrees on all seven. The whys are explicitly continuous ('stays yours', 'keeps Jax ahead'), which is the correct way to handle stages that do not differ. Nothing to change.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[] had only 3 entries — the 2+ items row was missing entirely (flagged in packet.defects), and no cooldown numbers appeared anywhere on the page.
audit.why: Locke's real numbers are: Ritual Nails 10s at rank 1 down to 6s from 950 range; his E is a flat 10s at every rank from 425; Purgatory is 120/100/80. The flat 10s on his only mobility is what makes 'punish the post-E window' a countable window rather than a slogan.
audit.corrected: spikes[3] created with before:null covering the 2+ items stage, and the numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Purgatory's grounding is never mentioned anywhere on the page. Every reference to his ultimate describes only the execute floor.
audit.why: Purgatory grounds. Grounding shuts off dashes, and Leap Strike is a dash — inside that zone your engage AND your escape simply do not fire. That is the single most important interaction in the matchup for a Jax player and the page omitted it completely, while telling him to 'disengage above the floor' from inside a zone he cannot dash out of.
audit.corrected: Written into report[5], breakdown.cooldowns and the new spikes[3].
sources: enemyKit R flags: grounding, execute, zone

audit.whatIsWrong: His E is described as a blink with an auto-reset, but the page never connects that reset to Counter Strike.
audit.why: Locke's E carries autoReset, so the bite at the end of the blink is a basic attack — which is exactly what Counter Strike eats. That is why 'let him engage into your E' works here, and the page asserts the conclusion without the reason.

edits.after: Purgatory is the one thing that beats you: it GROUNDS, so Leap Strike will not fire inside the ring — your engage and your exit both die at once. Step outside the zone before you commit, and never let a fight linger near his execute floor.
